recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition featuring a white mid-century ball chair centered on a stark white background. Inside the chair's purple-lined interior, only a pair of crossed legs in magenta heels are visible. Large-scale typography constructed from uniform dots wraps around and behind the central object.
coreVisualRelationships: Geometric circle of the chair vs. linear dot-matrix text
Partial reveal of the human figure for mystery

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium-scale ball chair acting as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark purple interior of the chair and the vertical line of the crossed legs.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top text, flows down the left side, circles the chair, and exits through the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central cluster to emphasize the pop-art aesthetic.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation magenta against high-value white creates a vibrant, clean look.

letterConstructionRules: Each glyph is composed of a grid of small, uniform circles
No solid strokes; only dot patterns define the shape
Uniform spacing between dots within the letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals are squared off by the grid
Curves are approximated by stepped dot placement

composition.overlap: behind and in front of subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family dot matrix used for all text to maintain graphic consistency.
graphicDevices: Layered depth (text behind chair, legs in front of text)

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky structure for dot fills.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio shot on a pure white background featuring a white Eero Aarnio style ball chair with a deep purple interior. A pair of legs in magenta high heels are crossed, extending out from the chair. High-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large uppercase text in a magenta dot-matrix style. Arrange the text in four horizontal lines, with the middle lines broken to wrap around the chair. Ensure the chair and legs appear to sit 'inside' the text layers for a 3D effect.

verificationChecks: Is the text composed entirely of dots?
Do the legs overlap the text in the foreground?
Is the magenta color consistent across text and shoes?

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the chair silhouette
Ensure the dot grid of the text is uniform
Verify the magenta color pops against the white
Confirm the legs are the only human element visible
recipe.reuseFormula: Central geometric furniture + partial human reveal + dot-matrix wrap-around typography + high-contrast limited palette.
